doc.title: Dan Morgenstern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 9, 2013

title: Thanks and closing
summary: Rowe and Morgenstern thank each other and end the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s a good point. Self promotion. Well we have an appointment with Amtrak, so I want to thank you for your time today.

Well I’ve really enjoyed my visit to Hamilton. I always wanted to come here. And you’ve got a really lovely spot here and I hope that I may be back someday. And it’s great that you also have all these live performances here.
That’s what it’s all about. All right. Thanks for your time. © Fillius Jazz Archive -23-
